programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The MTD team, led by Makuwa and Mirek, transporting the reactor to Belarus will have to deal with a sharp left turn and obstacles such as a house standing very close to the road, high curbs and a high-voltage pole.The Transdor team transporting the boat to the Bieszczady Mountains will have to be careful not to damage the load on the branches of roadside trees at the end of the route.Later it will unload at Solina.After making a wrong exit from the roundabout, JCS heading to the power plant in Kozienice will try to make up for lost time.However, the last section of the route will consist of local roads that will not allow for driving too fast.

programs.title: Supertruckers 3
programs.desc: The camera will visit employees of the Kings Heavy Haulage transport company, which operates in Bristol, England.The company has existed for over forty-five years.It is difficult to transport very large, problematic goods.Each new order is a real challenge for employees.Viewers will see how giant machines, vehicles or spare parts are transported - from loading onto trucks of similar size to delivery to the destination.All goods must reach customers intact.Truck drivers are still fighting against time.

programs.title: Mega Shippers
programs.desc: An army of specialists delivers special cargo all over the world on time.Some of them are huge, others - very valuable.

programs.title: Steel Buddies
programs.desc: Michael Manousakis and his mechanics from the Morlock Motors workshop will not despise any military vehicle.These are enthusiasts who can boast a long list of projects.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers 14
